title: NASA's Perseverance Mars rover breaks interplanetary driving record — and it's far from done
caption:
Perseverance has officially become the longest-distance driver in the history of Mars exploration. Surpassing the legendary Opportunity rover, it is now heading toward new geological targets.

Source: Space - NASA's Perseverance Mars rover breaks interplanetary driving record — and it's far from done
